def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    comp=[[-1]*w for _ in range(h)]
    cid=0
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=0 and comp[r][c]<0:
          stack=[(r,c)]; comp[r][c]=cid
          while stack:
            y,x=stack.pop()
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
              yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
              if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=0 and comp[yy][xx]<0:

          cid+=1
    seeds=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c] not in (0,1):
          seeds.append((r,c,grid[r][c]))
    # Match the 3x3 all-one motif around each colored seed within its component.
    for sr,sc,color in seeds:
      if not (1<=sr<h-1 and 1<=sc<w-1): continue
      if any(grid[y][x] not in (1,color) for y in range(sr-1,sr+2) for x in range(sc-1,sc+2)):
        continue
      comp_id=comp[sr][sc]
      for r in range(1,h-1):
        for c in range(1,w-1):
          if comp[r][c]==comp_id and all(grid[y][x]==1 for y in range(r-1,r+2) for x in range(c-1,c+2)):
            if out[r][c]==1: out[r][c]=color
    return out

def transform_nearest_in_component(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    comp=comp_ids(grid)
    seeds=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,1)]
    for sr,sc,color in seeds:
        if not (1<=sr<h-1 and 1<=sc<w-1): continue
        if any(grid[y][x]==0 for y in range(sr-1,sr+2) for x in range(sc-1,sc+2)): continue
    for r in range(1,h-1):
        for c in range(1,w-1):
            if not all(grid[y][x]!=0 for y in range(r-1,r+2) for x in range(c-1,c+2)): continue
            opts=[]
            for sr,sc,color in seeds:
                if comp[sr][sc]!=comp[r][c]: continue
                d=abs(sr-r)+abs(sc-c)
                opts.append((d,sr,sc,color))
            if opts and out[r][c]==1:
                out[r][c]=min(opts)[3]
    return out
